policy.privacy_text: When you use Neutra+, you entrust your data and information, and we commit to keeping this data protected through a protection system. In this sense, this privacy policy document clearly and accessibly explains how your information and data will be collected, used, shared, and stored by our systems. By using our services, you understand that we will collect and use your personal information in the ways described in this Policy, under the norms of the Federal Constitution of 1988 (art. 5º, LXXIX; and art. 22º, XXX – included by EC 115/2022), the Data Protection regulations (LGPD, Federal Law 13.709/2018), consumer provisions of Federal Law 8078/1990, and other applicable Brazilian legal standards.
policy.attention_text: Please be sure to read our Privacy Policy, because by using the platform and our services, you are subject to its applications. If in doubt, please contact us.
policy.terms_text: Welcome to Neutra+. We appreciate you using our provider interconnection platform. By using our services, you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.
policy.usage_policy_intro: To facilitate your understanding, this Terms of Use policy is divided as follows:
policy.personalized_experience: Provide a personalized experience for you.
policy.connect_with_people: Connect you with the people and organizations you care about.
policy.promote_safety: Promote the safety, protection, and integrity of our services, combat harmful conduct, and protect our user community.
policy.use_advanced_tech: Use and develop advanced technologies to provide secure and functional services for everyone.
policy.research_improvements: Research ways to improve our services.
policy.consistent_integrated_experience: Provide consistent and integrated experiences across Neutra+ services.
policy.user_commitment: Your commitment to Neutra+ and to our community.
policy.account_suspension: Suspension or termination of the account.
policy.attention_text_two: Please be sure to read our Terms of Use, because by using the platform and our services, you are subject to their applications. If in doubt, please contact us.
policy.legal_text: The services offered by Neutra+, a platform owned by BMO INOVA SIMPLES (I.S.), are intended exclusively for the telecommunications and ISP market. Neutra+ acts as an intermediary that facilitates network leasing, serving as a neutral agent between the parties. All contracts and terms agreed upon between providers and operators are the responsibility of the involved parties and Neutra+ as a neutral agent, with privacy policies available on our website and the links above.
